audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction of the matchup was never stated: Dr. Mundo's passive resists the first Immobilizing effect, which means Gragas's Body Slam stun is absorbed and a cannister drops. Also unstated: Drunken Rage reduces the damage Gragas takes for its window (an auto-reset burst tell), and Happy Hour heals him on every cast.
audit.why: Gragas's whole all-in is E stun into Q detonation; if the stun is eaten by the passive the combo becomes free damage on Mundo's terms.
audit.corrected: Stated the passive-vs-Body-Slam interaction in the cooldowns block, report[5], tradeGood and whys[4]; added Grievous Wounds vs Happy Hour and the Drunken Rage damage-reduction window.

audit.why: Riot data gives 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 — 13s is the rank-3 value, and the rank-1 number is what matters in the levels where you are punishing it.
